name: Banh uot Hoai Nhon
summary: Thin steamed rice sheets from Hoài Nhơn, stacked in layers and rolled with oil, fried scallion, and a sweet-sour fish sauce.
howToEat: Roll a piece, cut it, add a little oil and fried scallion, and dip it in sweet-sour fish sauce.
Or eat the sheets with grilled pork, bean sprouts, herbs, and a few slices of green mango.
seoTitle: Banh uot — steamed sheets in Hoai Nhon
seoDescription: Bánh ướt Hoài Nhơn is layered steamed rice sheets with oil, fried scallion, and sweet-sour fish sauce, or with grilled pork and herbs.
